description: Advisory review transport only. The trusted local verdict.schema.json and pilot policy remain authoritative.

baseSha.description: Exact baseSha from review-metadata.json: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

headSha.description: Exact headSha from review-metadata.json: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outcome.description: PASS requires zero findings. CHANGES_REQUESTED requires at least one actionable finding. BLOCKED requests human review.

summary.description: Nonempty advisory summary, at most 2000 characters.

findings.description: At most 30 findings, each tied to a changed file. Empty for PASS; nonempty for CHANGES_REQUESTED.

file.description: Exact repository-relative changed-file path, 1 to 512 characters.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence from the reviewed diff, 1 to 1500 characters.
